title: Hovey's Barbershop, Main Street, Adrian Hovey on the step
description: Boyer’s summer house was moved to the sidewalk and, over the years, was rented or sold to various businesses, including a jewellery store, Catelli’s Restaurant, a harness shop, and finally Ike Hovey’s Barbershop. The basement was also rented out and once housed a women’s clothing store called the Clothesline. The man on the step was Adrian Hovey, a barber and Ike’s son, before the building was torn down in 1984.
